mapper.select: SELECT hs.id, hs.homework_id, hs.student_id, hs.content, hs.submit_time, hs.score, hs.comment, hs.status, hs.is_late, hs.create_time, hs.update_time, hs.is_deleted, s.student_no, s.name AS student_name FROM homework_submission hs LEFT JOIN student s ON hs.student_id = s.id AND s.is_deleted = 0 WHERE hs.homework_id = #{homeworkId} AND hs.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY s.student_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO homework_submission (homework_id, student_id, content, submit_time, score, comment, status, is_late, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{homeworkId}, #{studentId}, #{content}, #{submitTime}, #{score}, #{comment}, #{status}, #{isLate}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)

INSERT INTO homework_submission (homework_id, student_id, content, submit_time, score, comment, status, is_late, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES
(#{item.homeworkId}, #{item.studentId}, #{item.content}, #{item.submitTime}, #{item.score}, #{item.comment}, #{item.status}, #{item.isLate}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE homework_submission SET content = #{content}, submit_time = #{submitTime}, score = #{score}, comment = #{comment}, status = #{status}, is_late = #{isLate}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE homework_submission SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE homework_id = #{homeworkId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM homework_submission WHERE homework_id = #{homeworkId} AND is_deleted = 0
